intervals.label: collaboration: data taking with the Omega spectrometer (Pb beam)
intervals.note: 1994: the pixel telescope for lead-ion events was built for WA97; 1996: the Omega facility closed at the end of 1996. The WA97 run years (1994-1996) are inferred from these two statements.
intervals.quote: In 1994, it was possible to construct the seven-layer, 0.5 million channel, silicon micro-pattern pixel detector telescope that allowed for electronically imaging the tracks on the lead-ion event in the WA97 experiment

intervals.label: collaboration: completed
intervals.note: Year precision: the Omega facility in the West Area was closed at the end of 1996; the programme moved to the North Area as NA57.
intervals.quote: The Omega facility was closed at the end of 1996.

summary.plain: The collaboration, led by Emanuele Quercigh, that ran the WA97 strangeness experiment at the CERN SPS Omega spectrometer.
summary.technical: WA97 Collaboration (spokesperson Emanuele Quercigh per arXiv:2603.10835); formation and membership not recorded.
